card.statement:
For any $\mathscr{A}_{1}$, $\mathscr{A}_{2}$ in $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$, there exists a canonical identification

$\mathsf{F}(\mathscr{A}_{1}\star\mathscr{A}_{2})=\mathsf{F}(\mathscr{A}_{1})\otimes_{\mathbf{k}}\mathsf{F}(\mathscr{A}_{2}).$
card.label: Proposition 8.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
